meta.title: Inside Out
meta.tagline: The city is a book. Someone tore out the last page.
meta.intro: Hidden across Antwerp are traces — street-art marks with a QR code or NFC tag. Each one opens a chapter of a case nobody solved. Find them, collect the fragments, and follow the clues to the final page.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — The First Page
chapters.intro: Placeholder intro. You found the first trace. Someone left this here on purpose, hoping the right person would look closer.
chapters.clue: Placeholder clue: where the river meets stone, the wall remembers a name.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — Water Remembers
chapters.intro: Placeholder intro. The second trace. The letters are older than the paint around them.
chapters.clue: Placeholder clue: the hands of the big clock point to the next page.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 — Lost Time
chapters.intro: Placeholder intro. Everything points to one place: a room full of frames, where the last page is hanging in plain sight.
chapters.clue: Placeholder clue: go to the museum. Stand in front of the artwork and scan it to open the final chapter.

chapters.title: Finale — Inside Out
chapters.intro: Placeholder finale. The artwork was the last page all along. The case is closed — for now.
chapters.clue: You solved the case. Claim your case card and share it.
